tooltips.mid: Midpoint of best yes-bid and yes-ask. Untradeable reference price.
tooltips.spreadCents: Best ask − best bid (¢). Wide spreads = poor liquidity; prefer postOnly.
tooltips.crossed: Transient book state (yesBid + noBid > 100). Do not treat mid as tradeable.
tooltips.avgKalshiVolumeFp: Mean resolved Kalshi contract volume over trading appearances (player_profiles). Not poly; not a single-tick kalshi_volume.
tooltips.yesPriceCents: Limit price for YES contracts, 1–99¢. NO price = 100 − yes.
tooltips.balanceCents: Available-to-trade cash. Does not include value locked in open positions.
tooltips.portfolioValueCents: Current mark value of all held positions, separate from cash balance.
tooltips.position: Signed contracts: positive = long YES, negative = long NO (Kalshi convention).
tooltips.exposureCents: Cash at risk in this market at current marks.
tooltips.realizedPnlCents: Locked-in profit/loss from closed trades in this market.
tooltips.feesPaidCents: Total exchange fees paid in this market, all time.
tooltips.remainingCount: Contracts still working on the book (not yet filled or canceled).
tooltips.fillCount: Contracts already executed from this order.
tooltips.isTaker: True = crossed the spread (taker fee); false = rested on book (maker fee, lower).
tooltips.feeCents: Exchange fee on this fill. Maker < taker — postOnly orders target maker fees.
tooltips.postOnly: Maker-first: order rests on book or is rejected; never crosses the spread.
tooltips.dryRun: Simulated order — no funds move, no API write. Live requires explicit opt-in.
tooltips.shadowMinSignals: Gate: minimum shadow signals before a program may graduate to pilot.
tooltips.killBrierDriftPct: Gate: kill program if Brier score drifts this % above baseline.
tooltips.graduationMinRealizedEdgeCentsPerFill: Gate: realized edge per fill needed for pilot→live.
tooltips.league: Professional circuit derived from Kalshi series (ATP, WTA, Challenger, ITF).
tooltips.surface: Court type: Hard, Clay, Grass, Carpet (from event or tournament seed).
tooltips.round: Match round within the tournament (R16, QF, SF, F, …).
tooltips.gender: Competition gender classification on the desk export.
tooltips.age_group: Age band when present (junior/senior); often empty on tour.
tooltips.match_uuid: Stable match identity for desk joins.
tooltips.timestamp: Snapshot capture time for the desk row.
tooltips.player_a: Side A player display name on the desk row.
tooltips.player_b: Side B player display name on the desk row.
tooltips.title: Match / event title string on the desk export.
tooltips.kalshi_mu: Kalshi mid (implied probability cents) on the desk snapshot.
tooltips.kalshi_spread: Kalshi bid–ask spread on the desk snapshot.
tooltips.kalshi_volume: Kalshi contract volume on the desk tick (not player-profile average).
tooltips.poly_mid: Polymarket mid price, cents; null when venue absent.
tooltips.poly_volume: Polymarket volume USD; null = venue absent, 0 = joined with zero trades.
tooltips.pinny_no_vig: Pinnacle no-vig probability in cents; null when unavailable.
tooltips.elo_prob: Elo win probability for player A (0–1); interpret with elo_source.
tooltips.elo_source: model | fallback_50 | missing — provenance of elo_prob.
tooltips.blend_fair_cents: Blended fair price in cents (core priced output).
tooltips.eff_edge: Effective edge vs blend (cents); tick-bound, can drift.
tooltips.liquidity_ok: Desk liquidity gate (necessary, not sufficient for tradable).
tooltips.total_volume_usd: Combined venue volume in USD for the match snapshot.
tooltips.multi_venue: Whether more than one venue is joined on the row.
tooltips.arb_hint: Directional arb signal (kalshi-cheap | poly-cheap | none | watch).
tooltips.arb_actionable: Hard arb gate (net edge > 0 on real venue-vs-venue).
tooltips.rps_flag: Research process signal flag on the desk row.
tooltips.graph_divergence: Graph/model divergence indicator on the desk export.
tooltips.export_note: Per-row provenance string (e.g. mock pinny caveat).
tooltips.playerProfiles: Derived from event-store player_profiles (SSOT). Rebuild: bun run tennis:profiles:build.
tooltips.lastSeenAtMs: Epoch millis of latest event start for this player. Capped ≤ now. Event-store ms.
tooltips.profilesSource: warehouse = rows from event-store; seed = unavailable / fixture path.
tooltips.coverage: Data completeness for a tour/surface slice (events with books, links, scores).
tooltips.surfaceEdge: Dampened percentage-point edge from each player's historical surface win rates vs the match surface.
tooltips.ui.events.filter.reset: Clear all active Events facet selections and sort order.
tooltips.ui.live_board.title: Real-time match monitor: open Kalshi markets with filters, surface edge, and player profiles.
tooltips.ui.live_board.scanner: Price divergence alert: when market mid deviates from model fair by more than threshold.
tooltips.ui.live_board.divergence: Cents difference between market price and model fair price.
tooltips.ui.live_board.edge_score: Composite signal strength: divergence weighted by liquidity and model confidence.

tooltips.ui.events.filter.country: Filter by tournament or player nationality code/name.

tooltips.ui.events.filter.min_vol: Minimum trailing volume gate for board rows (desk liquidity).

tooltips.ui.sort.events: Ordering of the match list: start time, volume, or name.
tooltips.ui.filter.unclassified: Placeholder when a value cannot be mapped to a known category.
tooltips.ui.warehouse.coverage: Data completeness badge: Kalshi-only, Polymarket-only, or hybrid.
tooltips.ui.warehouse.poly_link: Polymarket market link status: linked or unlinked.
tooltips.ui.warehouse.event_status: Match lifecycle: Scheduled, Live, or Ended.
tooltips.ui.warehouse.fleet_count: Number of matches in the current filtered view.
tooltips.ui.warehouse.fleet_volume: Aggregated volume across the filtered match set.
tooltips.composite.scanner: Abstract scanner / divergence-alert concept used by live board UI.
tooltips.alert.poly_dropout: kalshiOnly % exceeds threshold (>30% default) for N logger cycles. Polymarket matching failing.
tooltips.alert.volume_gap: midOnly exceeds threshold (>10 default) for N cycles. Many mids but zero volume — stale volume_fp.
tooltips.alert.feed_frozen: polyMatched=0 for N consecutive cycles. Polymarket feed completely frozen.
tooltips.alert.stale_feed: No snapshots within staleness-threshold-ms (120s). Logger stuck or crashed.
tooltips.alert.divergence: Kalshi mid deviates from Poly implied prob > divergence-cents (15¢). Cross-venue mispricing.
tooltips.alert.resolution: Auto-sent when active alert clears. Includes duration, replies original, clears debounce.
tooltips.alert.delivery: Telegram (HTML, threaded, keyboard CRITICAL), Discord/Slack webhook, console stderr.
tooltips.alert.severity: CRITICAL: feed down (keyboard). WARNING: degraded. INFO: informational, silent.
tooltips.ops.palette: Venue and domain colors with WCAG contrast audited. SSOT: src/lib/color/. See docs/COLORS.md + public/registry/color-system.json.
tooltips.kpi.open_matches: Count of active Kalshi events with tradable markets and non-crossed books.
tooltips.kpi.board_volume: Sum of 24-hour trading volume across all live board markets in USD.
tooltips.kpi.store_link_rate: Percentage of events successfully enriched with cross-market odds from Polymarket and Pinnacle.
tooltips.kpi.book_watches: Count of events with active WebSocket book price monitoring.
tooltips.kpi.player_profiles: Number of players with computed Elo ratings and player profiles in the index.
tooltips.kpi.live_scores: Count of events currently receiving live score updates from the ITF Stadion feed.
tooltips.kpi.rps_warnings: Count of events flagged with RPS (price-smoothed) anomaly warnings on the live board.
tooltips.kpi.graph_divergence: Count of events where Elo or odds graph signal deviates from market mid price beyond threshold.

tooltips.kpi.price_archive: Count of price snapshots stored in the archive table.
tooltips.kpi.archive_elo_fair: Count of price snapshot rows with Elo fair probability populated.
tooltips.kpi.server_errors: Count of logger error events recorded in the last 24 hours.
tooltips.kpi.top_edge: Maximum effective edge observed across all live board events.
tooltips.kpi.median_spread: Median bid-ask spread across all live board events in cents.
tooltips.kpi.tight_markets: Count of events where the bid-ask spread is below the liquidity threshold and both sides are non-null.
tooltips.kpi.scanner_alerts: Count of active price divergence scanner flags on the live board.

codes.DEP: deposit — funds in via Kalshi web/bank rails; reconciled, never API-initiated
codes.WDL: withdrawal — funds out via Kalshi web/bank rails; reconciled, never API-initiated
codes.FILL: fill — executed quantity against an order; has is_taker + fee_cost
codes.BAL: balance — available-to-trade cents; portfolio_value is separate
codes.FEE: fee — taker or maker, cents (taker_fees / maker_fees / fee_cost)
codes.BOOK: orderbook snapshot — bids/asks in yes-cents, integer levels
codes.MILE: Kalshi milestone — groups related event tickers
codes.RUN: research run — one discovery+score sweep, id = UTC timestamp
codes.SHDW: shadow signal — simulated decision, hash-chained in shadow-log.jsonl
codes.ALERT: pipeline alert — fired by price-logger when feed quality degrades
codes.RESV: alert resolution — auto-sent when active alert conditions clear

units.cents: integer cents, 1–99 for prices; canonical money unit everywhere
units.usd: US dollars (chart/export display; prefer cents interior)
units.dollarsFp: fixed-point dollar string e.g. "0.5600" — wire only, parse via dollarsToCents
units.countFp: fixed-point contract string e.g. "10.00" — fractional flagged, not orderable
units.pp: percentage points — edge / probability delta (e.g. surface edge)
units.atMs: epoch milliseconds — canonical absolute time (suffix AtMs)
units.unixSec: unix seconds — wire only (updated_ts, ts); multiply by 1000 at boundary
